questions.question: A program replaces all-reduce with reduce-scatter and immediately gathers the full vector again. What does the idealized ring model predict?
options: Half the communication of the original all-reduce.
The same two-phase payload, despite a temporarily smaller local result.
No communication because the global shape is unchanged.
questions.explanation: The scatter and gather each contribute one phase. The advantage depends on what consumes the partitioned value and when reconstruction is required.
